additions.name: God's Eye View
additions.description: 3D globe project for fusing satellite imagery and geospatial layers, built by the creator of a viral 'WorldView' YouTube series.
additions.notes: As of Sept 2026 this is a placeholder repo (541 stars) rebranding the creator's earlier 'WorldView' project; README states code is being prepared for public release targeting July 2026 and had not shipped at research time.

additions.name: Velocity
additions.description: Self-hosted console fusing live ADS-B aircraft, AIS ships, satellites, quakes, GPS jamming and conflict events onto one 3D globe with unlimited local history.
additions.notes: Keyless by default (no API keys needed for core feeds); optional keys for AISStream, OpenSky, FIRMS and ACLED extend coverage. Also exposes an MCP server for AI-agent queries.

additions.name: Satlas
additions.description: 3D globe tracking 30,000+ catalogued satellites and debris with an AI chat agent for orbital queries and per-location pass predictions.
additions.notes: Open source (PremaanshVyas/satlas); positions computed from Space-Track TLE catalog; public API documented at satlas.app/docs; free for non-commercial use.

additions.name: IntelSky
additions.description: Tracks 147,000+ military and government aircraft worldwide in real time and historically using unfiltered ADS-B feed data.
additions.notes: Independent project running since 2022; uses only publicly broadcast ADS-B signals, no classified data; no account or paywall for core functionality.

additions.name: SkyTrack
additions.description: Zero-dependency single-file web app tracking commercial, military and private aircraft on a 2D/3D globe with military/VIP detection and history playback.
additions.notes: Runs entirely client-side (no server/build step) against ADSB One/ADSB.lol/ADSB.fi/Airplanes.live; flags military, VIP/government and privacy-ICAO-address aircraft.

additions.name: Bellingcat Shadow Finder
additions.description: Maps every point on Earth where a shadow of a given length or sun angle could fall at a given date/time, to help geolocate where a photo was taken.
additions.notes: Runs via a free Google Colab notebook; part of Bellingcat's actively maintained OSINT toolkit (documentation updated 30 June 2026). Requires known object height or sun elevation angle plus image date/time.

additions.name: NISAR Public Data Archive
additions.description: Public archive of L-band and S-band synthetic aperture radar imagery from the NASA-ISRO NISAR mission for all-weather land, ice and vegetation change monitoring.
additions.notes: L-band data archived and openly available via the Alaska Satellite Facility DAAC; provisional data released 20 July 2026; S-band data separately released by ISRO via the Bhoonidhi portal.

additions.name: Umbra Space Open Data Program
additions.description: Free archive of commercial 25cm-resolution synthetic aperture radar satellite imagery, viewable day or night and through cloud cover.

additions.name: Capella Space Open Data
additions.description: AWS-hosted open archive of commercial SAR imagery browsable via a STAC catalog, for all-weather activity and change monitoring.

additions.name: EOPF Sentinel Zarr Samples Service
additions.description: ESA/Copernicus browser for Sentinel satellite data converted to the cloud-native Zarr format, with a STAC catalog and API for efficient partial-scene access.
additions.notes: Early-access service demonstrating ESA's new Zarr-based EOPF format across Sentinel missions; access via EOPF Sample Store and Analytics Hub notebooks.

additions.name: Google Earth Detect Change
additions.description: Experimental Google Earth tool that uses AI satellite embeddings to auto-generate a 10m heatmap of surface change between any two years from 2017-2025.
additions.notes: Web-only, experimental/pre-GA feature launched 26 May 2026; uses the AlphaEarth Foundations embedding model; limited to areas up to 200 sq km per layer and annual (not arbitrary date) comparisons.

additions.name: DeFlock
additions.description: Crowdsourced open map of Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) camera locations, including Flock Safety devices, across the USA.
additions.notes: Community-submitted data (137,951+ ALPRs mapped at research time); US-focused but a notable model for surveillance-camera crowdmapping generally.

additions.name: GPSJam
additions.description: Global interactive map of GPS/GNSS interference derived from aircraft ADS-B navigation-integrity data, updated daily.
additions.notes: Classifies interference as Low/Medium/High per region; current-day data may be incomplete; widely used as a data source by other fusion tools (e.g. Velocity).

additions.name: AIS Stream
additions.description: Free real-time WebSocket API streaming global AIS ship positions, port calls, voyage data and maritime accident/SAR-aircraft reports.
additions.notes: API key via GitHub login; free tier limited to 3 open connections per IP and per account; browser cannot connect directly, must proxy through your own server.

changes.name: ADS-B Exchange
changes.detail: Discontinued its free public API tier; unfiltered military/global ADS-B API access now requires a paid RapidAPI subscription.

changes.name: MarineTraffic
changes.detail: Cut its free vessel position-history replay window from 72 hours down to 24 hours.

changes.name: Flightradar24
changes.detail: Free-tier flight history/playback remains capped at 7 days; deeper historical replay requires a paid plan.

changes.name: Sentinel-1A
changes.detail: Sentinel-1A, the longstanding C-band SAR satellite, was retired on 29 June 2026 after 11 years in orbit; Sentinel-1C/1D now form the operational pair on the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem.
